paragraphs.text: Guest is an eternal creature type introduced in Unfinity .
A guest is a person who is invited to visit someone's home or attend a particular social occasion. In Unfinity , they are the visitors of " Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun ".
There is currently no plan to update older cards (i.e., Belligerent Guest , Gluttonous Guest ) with the creature type.
